1. Yo ______ levantarme a las cinco y media.
2. ¿Tú ______ hacer los deberes esta noche?
3. Mi hermana ______ repasar la historia.
4. Nosotros ______ llevar uniforme.
5. Vosotros ______ llegar a tiempo.
6. Los alumnos de Terminale ______ estudiar mucho.

Puis traduis la phrase 1 en français.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 4 — Escuchar: ¿Cómo es tu instituto?
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur le dialogue (leçon Escuchar). Réponds en espagnol, par des phrases complètes.

**A. Comprensión global — ¿Verdadero o falso?**
1. Divine y Santiago hablan de sus vacaciones.
2. Hay más alumnos en la clase de Divine que en la de Santiago.
3. Divine y Santiago quieren hacer la misma carrera.

**B. Comprensión detallada**
4. ¿A qué hora empiezan las clases de Divine? ¿A qué hora tiene que levantarse? ¿Por qué?
5. ¿Cuántos alumnos hay en la clase de Divine? ¿Y en la de Santiago?
6. ¿Cómo es el uniforme de Divine?
7. Cita dos reglas del instituto de Divine.
8. ¿Qué pasa si un alumno llega tarde?
9. ¿Cuáles son las asignaturas favoritas de Divine?
10. ¿Qué quiere estudiar Santiago y qué tiene que hacer para conseguirlo?
11. ¿Qué tiene que hacer Divine este sábado? ¿Por qué?

exercises.title: Ejercicio 7 — Vocabulario: relaciona y completa
exercises.statement:
**A. Relie chaque mot à sa définition.**

| Palabra | Definición |
|---|---|
| 1. el recreo | a. dinero para pagar los estudios |
| 2. la beca | b. no aprobar un examen |
| 3. suspender | c. la pausa entre dos clases |
| 4. el horario | d. el lugar donde se piden prestados libros |
| 5. la biblioteca | e. la lista de las clases de la semana con las horas |

**B. Completa con: aprobar, deberes, carrera, nota, uniforme.**
6. Saqué una buena ______ en el examen de español.
7. Después del instituto, quiero hacer la ______ de Derecho.
8. Cada noche hago los ______ antes de cenar.
9. Para ______ el bachillerato, hay que repasar.
10. En mi instituto hay que llevar ______.

exercises.title: Prueba final — Tareas de expresión escrita y oral
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Expresión escrita (70-90 palabras).** Écris cinq conseils à un élève qui entre en Terminale pour réussir son année. Utilise **hay que**, **tener que**, **deber**, **no hace falta** et **está prohibido** au moins une fois chacun.

**2. Expresión oral.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : « Describe un día normal en tu instituto y di qué quieres estudiar después del bachillerato. »

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Used to
exercises.statement:
Réécris chaque phrase avec **used to** ou **didn't use to**.

1. When I was a child, I played football in the street every evening.
2. My grandfather sang in a rumba orchestra in his youth. (He doesn't any more.)
3. In the past, people didn't watch matches on their phones.
4. My sister danced ndombolo at every family party when she was young.
5. Before his injury, he trained every morning.

Puis pose la question correspondant à la phrase 1, avec **Did… use to…?**

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Simple past or used to? Correct the mistakes
exercises.statement:
**A. Choisis entre le prétérit et used to.**
1. The Diables Rouges ______ (win) the African Cup of Nations in 1972.
2. As a child, she ______ (listen) to her father's rumba records every Sunday.
3. Two years ago, he ______ (break) the national record.
4. Before smartphones, young people ______ (buy) cassettes.

**B. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**
5. They didn't won the cup.
6. Did she sang at the concert?
7. I use to play the drums when I was ten.
8. He used to playing basketball.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 — Listening: Running for a dream
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur l'interview de Mireille (leçon Listening).

**A. Compréhension globale — True or False?**
1. Mireille is a footballer.
2. She has had an easy career.
3. She managed to combine sport and school.

**B. Compréhension détaillée**
4. How old was Mireille when she started athletics?
5. Where did she use to run? With whom?
6. Who noticed her, and where?
7. Why did she use to run barefoot?
8. What did her mother think of sport at first? What has changed?
9. What happened two years ago? How long couldn't she run?
10. What did her coach tell her?
11. What does Mireille have now, and what is her dream?

exercises.title: Exercise 6 — Reading: vocabulary and interpretation
exercises.statement:
**A. Find in the text a word or expression that means:**
1. together, by two or more people (paragraph 1)
2. the place where something begins (paragraph 2)
3. created, started (an orchestra) (paragraph 2)
4. went to many places (paragraph 3)
5. the side of a river (paragraph 5)

**B.** In paragraph 2, what does "records" mean? Is it the same meaning as in "He broke the national record"? Explain.

**C. Interpretation (4-5 sentences).**
6. "Culture can unite people across borders." Do you agree? Give an example from music or sport.

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Simple past or used to? Correct the mistakes
exercises.statement:
**A. Choisis entre le prétérit et used to.**
1. The Diables Rouges ______ (win) the African Cup of Nations in 1972.
2. As a child, she ______ (listen) to her father's rumba records every Sunday.
3. Two years ago, he ______ (break) the national record.
4. Before smartphones, young people ______ (buy) cassettes.

**B. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**
5. They didn't won the cup.
6. Did she sang at the concert?
7. I use to play the drums when I was ten.
8. He used to playing basketball.

exercises.title: Exercise 7 — Vocabulary: match and complete
exercises.statement:
**A. Relie chaque mot à sa définition.**

| Word | Definition |
|---|---|
| 1. a referee | a. the words of a song |
| 2. the lyrics | b. a person who trains a team |
| 3. a coach | c. the person who controls a match and applies the rules |
| 4. an audience | d. a person that young people admire and imitate |
| 5. a role model | e. the people who watch a concert or a show |

**B. Complète avec : beat, won, drew, scored, gave up.**
6. Congo ______ Gabon 3-1 in the qualifying match.
7. She ______ a gold medal at the African Games.
8. The two teams ______ 0-0, so there was a penalty shoot-out.
9. The striker ______ a fantastic goal.
10. He ______ music to become a doctor.

exercises.title: Exercise 8 — Put in order and translate
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. used / on / beach / to / the / she / run
2. the / didn't / we / match / win
3. began / when / career / his / he / fifteen / was
4. did / to / use / you / sing / a choir / in / ?

**B. Traduis en anglais.**
5. Quand j'étais petit, je jouais au football tous les soirs.
6. Les Diables Rouges ont gagné la Coupe d'Afrique en 1972.
7. Elle n'a pas abandonné après sa blessure.
8. Mon groupe préféré a enregistré un nouvel album l'année dernière.

exercises.title: Exercise 9 — Writing: a short biography (≈ 150 words)
exercises.statement:
**Topic:** Write the biography (about **150 words**) of an artist or an athlete you admire — real or imaginary.

Suis le plan chronologique de la leçon Writing. Utilise au moins six prétérits (dont trois irréguliers) et une phrase avec used to. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: End-of-unit test — Writing and speaking tasks
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Writing task (70-90 words).** Write about your childhood leisure activities. Compare what you **used to do** when you were a child and what you do now. Include **one special memory** told in the simple past.

**2. Speaking task.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : « Tell the story of a match, a race or a concert that you will never forget. »

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Simple past: complete the story
exercises.statement:
Mets les verbes entre parenthèses au **prétérit**.

Last Saturday, our school team (1) ______ (play) the final of the regional tournament. The match (2) ______ (begin) at four o'clock. At half-time, the other team (3) ______ (lead) 1-0 and we (4) ______ (not / feel) confident. Then our coach (5) ______ (speak) to us calmly. In the second half, Jordan (6) ______ (score) two goals and we (7) ______ (win) 2-1! After the match, the fans (8) ______ (sing) and danced in the street.

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Simple past: complete the story
exercises.statement:
Mets les verbes entre parenthèses au **prétérit**.

Last Saturday, our school team (1) ______ (play) the final of the regional tournament. The match (2) ______ (begin) at four o'clock. At half-time, the other team (3) ______ (lead) 1-0 and we (4) ______ (not / feel) confident. Then our coach (5) ______ (speak) to us calmly. In the second half, Jordan (6) ______ (score) two goals and we (7) ______ (win) 2-1! After the match, the fans (8) ______ (sing) and danced in the street.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 2 — Tener que, hay que o deber
exercises.statement:
**A. Complète avec la structure qui convient (tener que conjugué, hay que ou deber conjugué).**
1. Para aprobar el bachillerato, ______ trabajar todos los días. (règle générale)
2. Mañana yo ______ ir al médico, no puedo venir a clase. (obligation personnelle)
3. Los jóvenes ______ respetar a las personas mayores. (devoir moral)
4. En la biblioteca ______ hablar en voz baja. (règle générale)

**B. Absence d'obligation ou interdiction ? Complète avec no hace falta ou está prohibido.**
5. ______ usar el móvil durante el examen.
6. ______ traer el diccionario: hay uno en el aula.
7. ______ fumar en el instituto.
8. Es sábado: ______ levantarse temprano.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 5 — Leer: comprensión del texto
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur le texte « Dos institutos, dos realidades ».

**A. Comprensión global**
1. El texto: (a) explica cómo aprobar el bachillerato en Madrid (b) compara la vida de dos estudiantes de Brazzaville y de Madrid (c) cuenta la historia de un profesor.

**B. Comprensión detallada**
2. ¿A qué distancia de su casa está el instituto de Grâce? ¿Cómo va?
3. ¿Por qué muchos alumnos de Brazzaville comparten el manual?
4. ¿Cuál es el «secreto» de Grâce para aprobar?
5. ¿A qué hora empiezan las clases de Pablo? ¿Cuántos alumnos hay en su clase?
6. ¿Hasta qué edad son obligatorios los estudios en España?
7. ¿Qué tienen que hacer los alumnos españoles para ir a la universidad?
8. ¿Qué preocupaciones tienen en común Grâce y Pablo?
9. Cita tres consejos de los expertos.

**C. ¿Verdadero o falso? Justifica con una frase del texto.**
10. Pablo quiere ser médico.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 8 — Ordena y traduce
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. que / tengo / levantarme / a las cinco
2. hay / llevar / que / uniforme
3. prohibido / está / el móvil / usar / en clase
4. quiero / Medicina / estudiar / después del bachillerato

**B. Traduis en espagnol.**
5. Il faut réviser un peu chaque jour.
6. Je dois faire un exposé d'histoire ce week-end.
7. Il est interdit d'arriver en retard.
8. Ce n'est pas la peine d'acheter le livre.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Superlatives
exercises.statement:
Complète avec le **superlatif** de l'adjectif entre parenthèses.

1. Côte d'Ivoire is ______ (big) cocoa producer in the world.
2. Education is ______ (important) investment for a country.
3. For many people, debt is ______ (bad) problem of poor countries.
4. Some of ______ (good) African doctors work in Europe.
5. The farmers are ______ (poor) people in the chain.
6. This is ______ (profitable) part of the business.

Puis complète la règle : adjectif court → the + ______ ; adjectif long → the ______ + adjectif.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 — Listening: Is aid the answer?
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur le débat radiophonique (leçon Listening).

**A. Compréhension globale — True or False?**
1. Arnaud and Prisca completely agree.
2. Prisca thinks aid is useless in all situations.
3. Both speakers talk about young people leaving Africa.

**B. Compréhension détaillée**
4. What is the name of the radio programme?
5. According to Arnaud, what does foreign aid make possible? Give two examples.
6. In which situations is aid "the fastest solution", according to Arnaud?
7. Why does Prisca say that "the richest part of the value stays in the North"?
8. What are the two problems with aid and loans, according to Prisca?
9. Why do some African doctors work in Paris or Brussels?
10. What does Prisca propose to stop the brain drain?
11. Sum up each speaker's final answer in one sentence.

exercises.title: Exercise 5 — Reading: understanding the text
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur le texte « The long journey of a cocoa bean ».

**A. Global understanding**
1. The main idea of the text is: (a) how to make good chocolate at home (b) why cocoa farmers stay poor while chocolate companies get rich (c) the history of Côte d'Ivoire.

**B. Detailed understanding**
2. Who is Konan, and where does he live?
3. Give three steps of Konan's work on the beans.
4. What is surprising about Konan and chocolate?
5. Describe the journey of the beans from the village to the supermarket.
6. What happens to the beans in the European factories?
7. Who receives the biggest part of the price of a chocolate bar?
8. Give two advantages of fair trade mentioned in paragraph 4.
9. What have Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire decided to do?

**C. True or False? Justify.**
10. African chocolate brands are already as famous as European ones.

exercises.title: Exercise 6 — Reading: vocabulary and interpretation
exercises.statement:
**A. Find in the text a word or expression that means:**
1. from early morning to evening (paragraph 1)
2. to have enough money to buy (paragraph 1)
3. a part of a total (paragraph 3)
4. the crops collected in one season (paragraph 4)
5. more just, more equal (paragraph 5)

**B.** Explain in your own words: "the South produces the raw materials, but the North captures most of the added value" (paragraph 3).

**C. Interpretation (4-5 sentences).**
6. "The story of the cocoa bean is also the story of Congolese timber and oil." What does the author mean? Do you agree?

exercises.title: Exercise 8 — Put in order and translate
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. than / richer / the North / is / the South
2. the / is / education / best / solution
3. not / aid / effective / is / as / trade / as
4. we / the / process / more / the / we / richer / become

**B. Traduis en anglais.**
5. Les produits finis sont plus chers que les matières premières.
6. Le Congo exporte du pétrole et importe de l'essence.
7. C'est le pays le plus pauvre de la région.
8. Il y a moins de médecins dans les villages que dans les villes.

exercises.title: Exercise 9 — Writing: an argumentative essay (150-180 words)
exercises.statement:
**Topic:** "How can Southern countries reduce the North/South gap?"

Écris un essai de **150 à 180 mots** en suivant le plan de la leçon Writing : introduction, trois solutions illustrées, conclusion avec ton opinion. Utilise au moins trois comparatifs ou superlatifs. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: Exercise 9 — Writing: a report on transport (≈ 150 words)
exercises.statement:
**Topic:** Your town council has asked young people for ideas. Write a report (about **150 words**) entitled "Improving transport in our town". Describe the main problems and suggest three solutions.

Suis le plan de la leçon Writing (titre, introduction, situation actuelle, recommandations, conclusion). Utilise will et au moins un conditionnel avec if. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: Exercise 7 — Vocabulary: match and complete
exercises.statement:
**A. Relie chaque mot à sa définition.**

| Word | Definition |
|---|---|
| 1. raw materials | a. money that a country or a person must pay back |
| 2. debt | b. the departure of educated people to richer countries |
| 3. brain drain | c. natural products that are not yet transformed |
| 4. fair trade | d. the average number of years people live |
| 5. life expectancy | e. a system that pays producers a just price |

**B. Complète avec : gap, export, added value, invest, poverty.**
6. Congo mainly ______ oil and timber.
7. Many families in rural areas still live in ______.
8. Transforming cocoa into chocolate creates ______.
9. The ______ between rich and poor countries is still wide.
10. The government should ______ in schools and hospitals.

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Comparatives: complete the sentences
exercises.statement:
Complète avec le **comparatif de supériorité** de l'adjectif entre parenthèses et **than**.

1. Life in Europe is ______ (expensive) life in Congo.
2. The North is ______ (rich) the South.
3. Roads in the capital are ______ (good) roads in the villages.
4. A kilo of beans is ______ (cheap) a kilo of chocolate.
5. The situation in rural areas is ______ (bad) in the cities.
6. Industrial countries are ______ (developed) agricultural countries.
7. This year the harvest was ______ (big) last year.
8. Fair trade is ______ (fair) traditional trade.

exercises.title: Exercise 8 — Put in order and translate
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. than / richer / the North / is / the South
2. the / is / education / best / solution
3. not / aid / effective / is / as / trade / as
4. we / the / process / more / the / we / richer / become

**B. Traduis en anglais.**
5. Les produits finis sont plus chers que les matières premières.
6. Le Congo exporte du pétrole et importe de l'essence.
7. C'est le pays le plus pauvre de la région.
8. Il y a moins de médecins dans les villages que dans les villes.

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Will: predictions and decisions
exercises.statement:
**A. Complète avec will ou won't + le verbe entre parenthèses.**
1. I think the new road ______ (reduce) traffic jams.
2. Don't worry, the bus ______ (be) late today, the driver is always on time.
3. In 2050, most cars ______ (run) on electricity.
4. ______ the train ______ (stop) at Dolisie?
5. She doesn't like planes. She ______ (fly) to Pointe-Noire.

**B. Réagis à chaque situation avec une décision prise sur le moment (I'll…).**
6. Your grandmother has a heavy bag.
7. You missed the last bus.
8. Your friend doesn't know the way to the station.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 8 — Ordena y traduce
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. todo / sigue / recto / el semáforo / hasta
2. la segunda / toma / a la derecha / calle
3. al lado / la farmacia / está / del banco
4. el / coge / número 3 / autobús

**B. Traduis en espagnol.**
5. Traverse la rue et tourne à gauche. (tú)
6. Excusez-moi, madame, où est l'hôpital ?
7. Prenez le taxi, l'aéroport est loin. (usted)
8. Viens chez moi samedi et appelle-moi quand tu arrives à la gare.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 9 — Escribir: cómo llegar a mi casa (120-150 palabras)
exercises.statement:
**Tema :** Ton correspondant arrive dans ta ville ce week-end. Écris-lui un message de **120 à 150 mots** : explique-lui comment venir de la gare routière (ou de l'aéroport) jusqu'à chez toi, quel transport prendre, et donne-lui quelques conseils pour se déplacer dans ta ville.

Suis le plan de la leçon Escribir. Utilise au moins six impératifs (forme tú), dont deux irréguliers. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Whose: possession
exercises.statement:
Relie les deux phrases avec **whose**.

1. Sony Labou Tansi was a writer. His novels are studied in many countries.
2. I know a girl. Her mother is a famous singer.
3. Wangari Maathai was a scientist. Her work protected Kenya's forests.
4. This is the athlete. His record has never been beaten.
5. We met a farmer. His trees were planted by the Green Belt Movement.

Puis traduis la phrase 2 en français : quel mot français correspond à **whose** ?

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Combine the sentences and correct the mistakes
exercises.statement:
**A. Relie les phrases avec un pronom relatif. Mets des virgules si l'information est secondaire.**
1. My grandmother never went to school. She taught me to read.
2. Mandela was born in 1918. He became president in 1994.
3. The book changed my life. I read it last year.
4. 2004 was the year. Wangari Maathai received the Nobel Prize then.

**B. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**
5. The woman which lives next door is a nurse.
6. Mandela, that was a lawyer, fought apartheid.
7. The book that I read it was very interesting.
8. He is the writer who his novels are famous.
9. This is the hospital which I was born.

**C.** Dans la phrase 3 de la partie A, peut-on supprimer le pronom ? Pourquoi ?

exercises.title: Exercise 4 — Listening: Heroes next door
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur l'émission (leçon Listening).

**A. Compréhension globale — True or False?**
1. Maman Albertine is a famous television star.
2. She has worked as a midwife for a long time.
3. She thinks you must be famous to be important.

**B. Compréhension détaillée**
4. What is the name of the programme, and what is it about?
5. When did Albertine start working, and where?
6. How many babies has she delivered?
7. Who gave her the vocation? How?
8. Give two difficulties of her early years.
9. What is the achievement she is most proud of? Why is it useful?
10. What is her "award"?
11. What advice does she give to young people?

exercises.title: Exercise 6 — Reading: vocabulary and interpretation
exercises.statement:
**A. Find in the text a word or expression that means:**
1. to go and get (water) (paragraph 1)
2. money given to a student to pay for studies (paragraph 2)
3. rare, difficult to find (paragraph 3)
4. the cutting down of forests (paragraph 3)
5. to stop a fire (paragraph 5)

**B.** In paragraph 4, what does "which" refer to in "…human rights, which made her many enemies"?

**C. Interpretation (4-5 sentences).**
6. Wangari said that peace is impossible when people fight over land, water and wood. Explain this idea and give an example from Africa or elsewhere.

exercises.title: Exercise 7 — Vocabulary: match and complete
exercises.statement:
**A. Relie chaque mot à sa définition.**

| Word | Definition |
|---|---|
| 1. a legacy | a. a woman who helps mothers give birth |
| 2. a role model | b. what a person leaves to future generations |
| 3. a midwife | c. a person that others admire and imitate |
| 4. humble | d. to succeed in dealing with a difficulty |
| 5. to overcome | e. not proud, modest |

**B. Complète avec : achievement, grew up, award, inspired, dedicated.**
6. She ______ her life to the education of girls.
7. He was born in Brazzaville but he ______ in Pointe-Noire.
8. Building a school in her village was her greatest ______.
9. Mandela's courage has ______ millions of people.
10. The writer received an important literary ______.

exercises.title: Exercise 8 — Put in order and translate
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. who / she / the woman / is / planted / trees / millions of
2. the village / this / where / born / is / I / was
3. a writer / he / novels / whose / was / famous / are
4. the prize / won / she / that / is / the Nobel Prize

**B. Traduis en anglais.**
5. Mandela est l'homme qui a passé vingt-sept ans en prison.
6. C'est le livre que j'ai lu l'année dernière.
7. Je connais un garçon dont le père est médecin.
8. Ma grand-mère, qui n'est jamais allée à l'école, est mon modèle.

exercises.title: Exercise 9 — Writing: portrait of a person you admire (150-180 words)
exercises.statement:
**Topic:** Write a portrait (150 to 180 words) of a person you admire: a famous person or someone from your family or community.

Suis le plan de la leçon Writing. Utilise au moins quatre pronoms relatifs différents. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: End-of-unit test — Writing and speaking tasks
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Writing task (70-90 words).** Define a hero. Use at least **four relative clauses** (who, which, whose, where…). Example of beginning: « For me, a hero is a person who… »

**2. Speaking task.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : « Present a famous African person whose life inspires you. »

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Who, which or where?
exercises.statement:
Complète avec **who**, **which** ou **where**.

1. Mandela is the leader ______ spent twenty-seven years in prison.
2. This is the school ______ my father studied.
3. The Nobel Peace Prize is an award ______ is given every year.
4. A midwife is a woman ______ helps mothers give birth.
5. Dolisie is the town ______ Maman Albertine works.
6. The book ______ I am reading is about Wangari Maathai.
7. The students ______ won the competition will travel to Brazzaville.
8. Kenya is the country ______ the Green Belt Movement was created.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Whose: possession
exercises.statement:
Relie les deux phrases avec **whose**.

1. Sony Labou Tansi was a writer. His novels are studied in many countries.
2. I know a girl. Her mother is a famous singer.
3. Wangari Maathai was a scientist. Her work protected Kenya's forests.
4. This is the athlete. His record has never been beaten.
5. We met a farmer. His trees were planted by the Green Belt Movement.

Puis traduis la phrase 2 en français : quel mot français correspond à **whose** ?

exercises.title: Ejercicio 7 — Vocabulario: relaciona y completa
exercises.statement:
**A. Relie chaque mot à sa définition.**

| Palabra | Definición |
|---|---|
| 1. la receta | a. una medicina líquida para la tos |
| 2. el jarabe | b. el papel donde el médico escribe los medicamentos |
| 3. la mosquitera | c. una temperatura del cuerpo muy alta |
| 4. la fiebre | d. un producto que protege contra una enfermedad |
| 5. la vacuna | e. una red que protege de los mosquitos |

**B. Completa con: garganta, pastillas, constipado, rodilla, sano.**
6. Me he caído y me he herido en la ______.
7. Tengo que tomar dos ______ al día.
8. Estoy ______: tengo la nariz tapada y estornudo mucho.
9. Me duele la ______ y no puedo tragar.
10. Para estar ______, hay que comer bien y hacer deporte.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 8 — Ordena y traduce
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. fiebre / he / toda / tenido / la noche
2. ha / me / el médico / una receta / dado
3. la cabeza / me / mucho / duele
4. paludismo / nunca / he / tenido

**B. Traduis en espagnol.**
5. Je suis allé au centre de santé ce matin.
6. Ma sœur s'est cassé le bras.
7. Tu as déjà pris tes médicaments ?
8. J'ai mal aux pieds parce que j'ai beaucoup marché aujourd'hui.

exercises.title: Prueba final — Tareas de expresión escrita y oral
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Expresión escrita (70-90 palabras).** Écris ce que tu as fait **cette semaine** pour ta santé, et ce que tu n'as **pas encore** fait. Utilise au moins **cinq pretéritos perfectos**, **ya** et **todavía no**.

**2. Expresión oral.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : joue le rôle d'un patient chez le médecin ; explique tes symptômes et ce qui t'est arrivé.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Be going to: plans and evidence
exercises.statement:
**A. Complète avec la bonne forme de be going to + le verbe.**
1. We ______ (visit) our cousins in Ouesso next month.
2. My brother ______ (not / buy) a motorbike; he's too young.
3. ______ you ______ (take) the train or the bus?
4. The government ______ (build) a new bridge over the river.

**B. Que va-t-il se passer ? Utilise be going to (évidence).**
5. The taxi driver is driving very fast and the road is wet.
6. The bus is full and there are still twenty people at the bus stop.
7. It's 7:58 and the train leaves at 8:00. We are still at home.

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Will or going to? First conditional and mistakes
exercises.statement:
**A. Choisis will ou be going to.**
1. A: The phone is ringing. — B: OK, I ______ (answer) it.
2. I've bought my ticket. I ______ (travel) on Saturday.
3. I think public transport ______ (improve) in the future.
4. Look at those black clouds! It ______ (rain).

**B. Mets les verbes à la bonne forme (conditionnel de type 1).**
5. If the city ______ (build) bus lanes, traffic ______ (decrease).
6. If you ______ (not / wear) a helmet, you ______ (be) in danger.
7. When we ______ (arrive) in Pointe-Noire, we ______ (call) you.

**C. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**
8. I will to take the bus tomorrow.
9. If it will rain, we will stay at home.
10. They are going to built a railway.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 — Listening: Train or bus to Pointe-Noire?
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur la conversation (leçon Listening).

**A. Compréhension globale — True or False?**
1. Christelle and Junior are going to Pointe-Noire for work.
2. They finally choose the plane.
3. Fabrice made the journey recently.

**B. Compréhension détaillée**
4. Who are they going to visit?
5. How did Fabrice travel, and how long did the journey take?
6. What frightened Fabrice during his journey?
7. Give two advantages of the train according to Fabrice.
8. Why don't they take the plane?
9. Why does Junior want to take the train?
10. What are they going to do before buying tickets? Why must they book early?
11. What will Junior and Christelle do to prepare the trip?

exercises.title: Ejercicio 1 — Forma el pretérito perfecto
exercises.statement:
Mets les verbes au **pretérito perfecto**.

1. Yo ______ (tener) fiebre toda la noche.
2. ¿Tú ______ (tomar) la pastilla?
3. Mi hermana ______ (ir) al centro de salud.
4. Nosotros ______ (comer) fruta esta mañana.
5. ¿Vosotros ______ (dormir) bajo la mosquitera?
6. Los médicos ______ (vacunar) a los niños del barrio.
7. Hoy mi madre no ______ (trabajar) porque está enferma.
8. Esta semana yo ______ (beber) mucha agua.

exercises.title: Exercise 8 — Put in order and translate
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. going / visit / we / to / are / grandparents / our
2. think / will / I / be / the train / late
3. if / builds / the city / will / traffic / decrease / bus lanes,
4. you / are / going / how / to / travel / ?

**B. Traduis en anglais.**
5. Nous allons prendre le train pour Pointe-Noire.
6. Je pense que les voitures seront électriques en 2050.
7. Si tu rates le bus, tu arriveras en retard.
8. Ne t'inquiète pas, je vais porter ton sac. (décision sur le moment)

exercises.title: Exercise 9 — Writing: a report on transport (≈ 150 words)
exercises.statement:
**Topic:** Your town council has asked young people for ideas. Write a report (about **150 words**) entitled "Improving transport in our town". Describe the main problems and suggest three solutions.

Suis le plan de la leçon Writing (titre, introduction, situation actuelle, recommandations, conclusion). Utilise will et au moins un conditionnel avec if. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Be going to: plans and evidence
exercises.statement:
**A. Complète avec la bonne forme de be going to + le verbe.**
1. We ______ (visit) our cousins in Ouesso next month.
2. My brother ______ (not / buy) a motorbike; he's too young.
3. ______ you ______ (take) the train or the bus?
4. The government ______ (build) a new bridge over the river.

**B. Que va-t-il se passer ? Utilise be going to (évidence).**
5. The taxi driver is driving very fast and the road is wet.
6. The bus is full and there are still twenty people at the bus stop.
7. It's 7:58 and the train leaves at 8:00. We are still at home.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 4 — Escuchar: en el centro de salud
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur la consultation (leçon Escuchar). Réponds en espagnol, par des phrases complètes.

**A. Comprensión global — ¿Verdadero o falso?**
1. Santiago va al médico porque se ha roto un brazo.
2. Santiago tiene paludismo.
3. La doctora dice que Santiago puede volver a clase mañana.

**B. Comprensión detallada**
4. ¿Qué síntomas tiene Santiago? (cuatro)
5. ¿Desde cuándo tiene fiebre?
6. ¿Ha comido algo hoy? ¿Por qué?
7. ¿Cuándo ha llegado Santiago a Brazzaville?
8. ¿Por qué no ha usado la mosquitera la primera noche?
9. ¿Qué prueba le hace la doctora? ¿Qué necesita?
10. ¿Qué tratamiento le da la doctora? ¿Durante cuánto tiempo?
11. Cita tres consejos de la doctora.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 7 — Vocabulario: relaciona y completa
exercises.statement:
**A. Relie chaque métier à ce que fait la personne.**

| Profesión | Actividad |
|---|---|
| 1. el abogado | a. cultiva la tierra |
| 2. el agricultor | b. defiende a sus clientes |
| 3. el periodista | c. arregla los coches |
| 4. el mecánico | d. hace muebles de madera |
| 5. el carpintero | e. escribe artículos y hace entrevistas |

**B. Completa con: paro, prácticas, currículum, sueldo, entrevista.**
6. Mi vecino no tiene trabajo: está en ______.
7. Envía tu ______ y una carta de presentación.
8. Este verano haré ______ en una empresa petrolera.
9. El jefe me hará una ______ el lunes.
10. Es un buen trabajo, pero el ______ es bajo.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 8 — Ordena y traduce
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. del bachillerato / después / estudiaré / Medicina
2. tendré / taller / mi / propio / algún día
3. habrá / empleos / en el futuro / más / verdes
4. voy / mi currículum / a / esta tarde / enviar

**B. Traduis en espagnol.**
5. L'année prochaine, je ferai un stage dans une banque.
6. Si je trouve du travail, j'aiderai ma famille.
7. Dans dix ans, ma sœur sera avocate.
8. Mon voisin est au chômage depuis un an.

exercises.title: Prueba final — Tareas de expresión escrita y oral
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Expresión escrita (70-90 palabras).** Fais cinq prédictions sur le travail au Congo en 2050. Utilise au moins **six verbes au futur**, dont **habrá** et deux autres irréguliers.

**2. Expresión oral.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : passe un entretien d'embauche pour un emploi de vacances (présente-toi, tes qualités, ton expérience, et fais trois promesses au futur).

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — The passive at other tenses
exercises.statement:
Mets les phrases au passif, en gardant le temps.

1. They will plant a thousand trees next year. (futur)
2. They have collected three hundred bags. (present perfect)
3. We must protect endangered species. (modal)
4. They are building a new recycling centre. (présent en -ing)
5. You should recycle plastic bottles. (modal)
6. The authorities have banned plastic bags. (present perfect)

Puis traduis en anglais avec un passif : « Ici, on trie les déchets. »

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Connectors and mistakes
exercises.statement:
**A. Complète avec because, because of, so ou as a result.**
1. The streets were flooded ______ the gutters were blocked.
2. The road was closed ______ the heavy rain.
3. Trees are cut down for charcoal, ______ the soil is eroded.
4. The forest is disappearing. ______, many animals are in danger.

**B. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**
5. The river is pollute by the factory.
6. Thousands of trees cut down every year.
7. A new school will built next year.
8. The forest must protected.
9. The houses were destroyed of the flood.
10. The road was closed because the rain.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 — Listening: Cleaning the Côte Sauvage
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur le reportage (leçon Listening).

**A. Compréhension globale — True or False?**
1. The clean-up is organised by the town council.
2. Most of the rubbish found is plastic.
3. The fisherman thinks the situation has improved.

**B. Compréhension détaillée**
4. How many volunteers came, and who were they?
5. What was given to everybody?
6. Give four kinds of rubbish found on the beach.
7. How many bags have been filled?
8. Explain how plastic from the town arrives on the beach.
9. What will happen to the bags and the plastic bottles?
10. How does plastic affect Mr Okemba's work? Give two effects.
11. What are the club's next plans?

exercises.title: Exercise 8 — Put in order and translate
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. cut down / trees / are / every year / thousands of
2. by / was / the beach / volunteers / cleaned
3. must / the forest / protected / be
4. will / next year / built / a recycling centre / be

**B. Traduis en anglais.**
5. Le fleuve est pollué par les usines.
6. Cinquante maisons ont été détruites par l'inondation.
7. On ramasse les ordures tous les lundis.
8. Les rues sont inondées parce que les caniveaux sont bouchés.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 3 — Futuro proche, condición y corrección de errores
exercises.statement:
**A. Transforme au futur proche (ir a + infinitif).**
1. Esta tarde envío mi currículum.
2. Mañana tenemos una entrevista.
3. ¿Qué haces el sábado?

**B. Complète la condition (si + présent, futur).**
4. Si ______ (aprobar) el bachillerato, ______ (estudiar) Agronomía.
5. Si ______ (encontrar) trabajo, ______ (poder) ayudar a mis padres.

**C. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**
6. Teneré un buen sueldo.
7. Si aprobaré, haré una fiesta.
8. Voy trabajar en un hotel.
9. Habrán muchos empleos verdes.
10. Haceré prácticas en una empresa.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 6 — Leer: vocabulario e interpretación
exercises.statement:
**A. Busca en el texto la palabra o expresión que significa:**
1. una persona que tiene un diploma (párrafo 1)
2. estar de acuerdo (párrafo 2)
3. muy importante, esencial (párrafo 3)
4. la superficie de la tierra donde se cultiva (párrafo 3)
5. la persona que da trabajo (párrafo 5)

**B.** Explique en français la phrase : « el mejor trabajador no será el que más sabe, sino el que más aprende ». Quelle structure signifie « non pas… mais » ?

**C. Interpretación (4-5 frases en español).**
6. Según tú, ¿cuál será el sector más importante para los jóvenes congoleños en el futuro? Justifica tu respuesta con el futuro.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 9 — Escribir: mi vida dentro de diez años (120-150 palabras)
exercises.statement:
**Tema :** Imagine ta vie dans dix ans. Écris un texte de **120 à 150 mots** : où vivras-tu ? Quelles études auras-tu faites ? Quel sera ton travail ? Comment sera ta journée ? Comment aideras-tu ta famille ou ton pays ?

Suis le plan de la leçon Escribir. Utilise au moins huit verbes au futur, dont trois irréguliers, et une condition avec si. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: Prueba final — Tareas de expresión escrita y oral
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Expresión escrita (70-90 palabras).** Raconte la dernière fois que tu es allé(e) à une fête, un concert ou un match. Utilise au moins **huit verbes à l'indefinido**, dont trois irréguliers, et des connecteurs (primero, después, al final).

**2. Expresión oral.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : « ¿Qué hiciste el fin de semana pasado? »

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — The passive: present and past
exercises.statement:
**A. Mets les phrases au passif (présent simple). N'ajoute pas l'agent s'il est inutile.**
1. People throw plastic bags into the gutters.
2. They collect the rubbish every Monday.
3. Factories pollute the river.
4. People use charcoal for cooking.

**B. Mets les phrases au passif (prétérit).**
5. The flood destroyed fifty houses.
6. Volunteers cleaned the beach.
7. Somebody stole my bicycle.
8. The government created a national park in 1935.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 2 — Verbos irregulares en indefinido
exercises.statement:
Mets les verbes au **pretérito indefinido** (irréguliers).

1. El sábado yo ______ (ir) al estadio con mi padre.
2. El concierto ______ (ser) maravilloso.
3. Ayer nosotros ______ (tener) entrenamiento.
4. ¿Qué ______ (hacer) tú el domingo?
5. Santiago ______ (hacer) dos goles.
6. Mis primos ______ (venir) a la fiesta.
7. El entrenador nos ______ (decir) «¡Bravo!».
8. Yo no ______ (poder) ir al concierto.
9. Mi abuelo ______ (dormir) durante el partido.
10. Los aficionados ______ (estar) muy contentos.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 5 — Leer: comprensión del texto
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur le texte « La rumba y el flamenco, patrimonio de la humanidad ».

**A. Comprensión global**
1. El texto: (a) explica cómo bailar flamenco (b) presenta la historia de dos músicas reconocidas por la UNESCO (c) cuenta un concierto en Madrid.

**B. Comprensión detallada**
2. ¿Qué es el «patrimonio cultural inmaterial»? Da dos ejemplos.
3. ¿En qué año fueron inscritos el flamenco y la rumba congoleña?
4. ¿Dónde nació el flamenco? ¿Qué culturas lo crearon?
5. ¿Cuáles son los tres elementos del flamenco?
6. ¿Cuándo y dónde nació la rumba congoleña?
7. ¿Qué escucharon los músicos locales?
8. ¿Qué orquesta se fundó en Brazzaville en 1959?
9. ¿Qué otros estilos nacieron de la rumba?

**C. ¿Verdadero o falso? Justifica con una frase del texto.**
10. La República del Congo presentó sola la candidatura de la rumba.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 8 — Ordena y traduce
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. fui / el sábado / a / de rumba / un concierto
2. dos / marcó / goles / Santiago
3. ganamos / a / tres / uno
4. hasta / bailamos / medianoche

**B. Traduis en espagnol.**
5. Hier, j'ai joué au football avec mes amis.
6. Le concert a été inoubliable.
7. Il y a deux ans, mon équipe a gagné le championnat.
8. J'adore la musique, mais je n'aime pas du tout danser.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Prepositions + -ing
exercises.statement:
Complète avec la préposition qui convient (in, at, of, about, without, before) et le verbe à la forme **-ing**.

1. I'm interested ______ (work) in a hotel.
2. She is very good ______ (repair) phones.
3. He's tired ______ (look) for a job.
4. Read the advertisement again ______ (go) to the interview.
5. You can't succeed ______ (work) hard.
6. I'm thinking ______ (start) my own business.

Puis termine cette lettre avec la formule correcte : « I look forward ______ (hear) from you. »

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Gerund as subject, would like and mistakes
exercises.statement:
**A. Transforme selon le modèle. Modèle : It is difficult to find a job. → Finding a job is difficult.**
1. It is useful to speak English.
2. It is exciting to start a business.
3. It is tiring to work at night.

**B. Like + -ing ou would like + to ? Complète.**
4. I like ______ (meet) new people. (en général)
5. I would like ______ (meet) the manager. (souhait précis)

**C. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**
6. I enjoy to help customers.
7. I'm interested in to work for your company.
8. I look forward to meet you.
9. I want working abroad.
10. Find a good job is not easy.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 — Listening: A job interview
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur l'entretien (leçon Listening).

**A. Compréhension globale — True or False?**
1. Exaucé is applying for a permanent job.
2. He has some work experience.
3. The interview goes badly.

**B. Compréhension détaillée**
4. What has Exaucé just done? What does he plan to do next year?
5. Where has he worked, and what has he learnt there?
6. What languages does he speak? How does he practise English?
7. What would he do with an angry guest? Give three actions.
8. What does the job involve? What is Exaucé's answer?
9. What is his greatest weakness?
10. Where does he see himself in ten years?
11. What will happen before he starts the job? When will he get an answer?

exercises.title: Exercise 7 — Vocabulary: match and complete
exercises.statement:
**A. Relie chaque mot à sa définition.**

| Word | Definition |
|---|---|
| 1. a vacancy | a. a period of work in a company to gain experience |
| 2. an internship | b. a job that is available |
| 3. to hire | c. a person who works for a company |
| 4. an employee | d. to give a job to somebody |
| 5. reliable | e. that people can trust |

**B. Complète avec : interview, skills, apply, salary, self-employed.**
6. I would like to ______ for the position of shop assistant.
7. The ______ is paid at the end of every month.
8. She is ______: she has her own sewing workshop.
9. Computer ______ are essential for this job.
10. Be punctual and polite during the job ______.

exercises.title: End-of-unit test — Writing and speaking tasks
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Writing task (70-90 words).** Describe your dream job. Say what you would like to do, what you enjoy doing, what you are good at and what you need to do to get this job. Use at least **three gerunds** and **three infinitives**.

**2. Speaking task.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : réponds à la question d'entretien « Tell me about yourself and why you want this job » (choisis un poste).

exercises.title: Ejercicio 2 — Verbos irregulares y ojalá
exercises.statement:
**A. Mets au présent du subjonctif (verbes irréguliers).**
1. Es necesario que todos ______ (hacer) un esfuerzo.
2. Quiero que el barrio ______ (estar) limpio.
3. Ojalá ______ (haber) menos basura el año que viene.
4. Es importante que los niños ______ (saber) reciclar.
5. Pido que tú ______ (ir) a la reunión del club.
6. Ojalá el planeta ______ (ser) más limpio para nuestros hijos.
7. Es necesario que el alcalde nos ______ (dar) un camión.
8. Quiero que mis amigos ______ (venir) a la jornada de limpieza.

**B. Exprime un souhait avec ojalá.**
9. Je souhaite qu'il pleuve. → ______
10. Je souhaite que les gorilles ne disparaissent pas. → ______

exercises.title: Ejercicio 3 — Infinitivo o subjuntivo, imperativo negativo y errores
exercises.statement:
**A. Infinitif ou que + subjonctif ? Complète.**
1. Yo quiero ______ (reciclar) mis botellas. (même sujet)
2. Yo quiero que mi hermano ______ (reciclar) sus botellas.
3. Es necesario ______ (proteger) los ríos. (en général)
4. Planto árboles para que mis hijos ______ (respirar) aire limpio.

**B. Mets à l'impératif négatif (forme tú).**
5. Tira la basura en la calle. → ______
6. Quema el plástico. → ______
7. Corta los árboles. → ______

**C. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**
8. Es necesario que reciclamos el plástico.
9. Ojalá llueve mañana.
10. ¡No tira la basura aquí!

exercises.title: Ejercicio 5 — Leer: comprensión del texto
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur le texte « Un mundo sin plástico: ¿es posible? ».

**A. Comprensión global**
1. El texto: (a) explica cómo se fabrica el plástico (b) presenta el problema del plástico, ejemplos de soluciones y consejos (c) cuenta la historia de una empresa.

**B. Comprensión detallada**
2. Cita tres cualidades del plástico.
3. ¿Cuál es su gran defecto?
4. ¿Qué advierten algunos científicos?
5. ¿Cómo provocan inundaciones las bolsas en las ciudades africanas?
6. ¿Por qué es peligroso quemar el plástico?
7. ¿Qué hicieron Ruanda y Kenia?
8. ¿Por qué España obliga a las tiendas a cobrar las bolsas?
9. Cita tres consejos de los expertos para los ciudadanos.

**C. ¿Verdadero o falso? Justifica con una frase del texto.**
10. Según el texto, es posible eliminar totalmente el plástico.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 8 — Ordena y traduce
exercises.statement:
**A. Remets les mots dans l'ordre.**
1. que / es necesario / reciclemos / el plástico
2. tires / no / la basura / en la calle
3. ojalá / pronto / llueva
4. que / quiero / limpio / el barrio / esté

**B. Traduis en espagnol.**
5. Il est urgent que nous protégions les forêts.
6. Ne brûle pas les ordures ! (tú)
7. Je plante des arbres pour que mes enfants respirent un air pur.
8. Pourvu que les gens comprennent le problème !

exercises.title: Exercise 9 — Writing: a letter of application (≈ 150 words)
exercises.statement:
**Topic:** "Hotel Atlantic, Pointe-Noire, is looking for young receptionists for the summer holidays. Good English required. Send your application to Mrs Mavoungou, Human Resources Manager."

Écris une **lettre de motivation formelle** d'environ **150 mots**, en suivant la présentation et le plan de la leçon Writing. Utilise au moins trois gérondifs et trois infinitifs, sans contractions. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Verb + -ing or to?
exercises.statement:
Mets le verbe entre parenthèses à la bonne forme : **-ing** ou **to + base verbale**.

1. I enjoy ______ (work) with children.
2. She decided ______ (become) a nurse.
3. Do you mind ______ (work) at weekends?
4. I would like ______ (apply) for this job.
5. He finished ______ (write) his CV.
6. They hope ______ (open) a restaurant next year.
7. Avoid ______ (arrive) late for the interview.
8. You need ______ (send) your application before Friday.
9. My sister learnt ______ (sew) when she was fifteen.
10. I suggest ______ (call) the manager.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 6 — Leer: vocabulario e interpretación
exercises.statement:
**A. Busca en el texto la palabra o expresión que significa:**
1. que no pesa mucho (párrafo 1)
2. avisar de un peligro (párrafo 1)
3. el dinero que se paga como castigo (párrafo 3)
4. una persona que crea una empresa (párrafo 3)

**B.** Dans le paragraphe 4, relève trois verbes au subjonctif, donne leur infinitif et l'expression qui les introduit.

6. ¿Crees que el Congo debe prohibir las bolsas de plástico? Usa al menos dos subjuntivos (es necesario que, quiero que, ojalá…).

exercises.title: Prueba final — Tareas de expresión escrita y oral
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Expresión escrita (70-90 palabras).** Écris cinq souhaits et demandes pour l'environnement de ton pays. Utilise **ojalá**, **es necesario que**, **quiero que**, **para que** et un **impératif négatif**.

**2. Expresión oral.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : présente un problème écologique de ta ville et propose des solutions.

exercises.title: Prueba final — Tareas de expresión escrita y oral
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Expresión escrita (70-90 palabras).** Décris ta vie quand tu avais huit ans : où tu habitais, ce que tu faisais après l'école, à quoi tu jouais, quelle technologie il y avait chez toi. Utilise au moins **huit imperfectos**.

**2. Expresión oral.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : « Ventajas y peligros del teléfono móvil ».

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Must or mustn't?
exercises.statement:
Complète avec **must** ou **mustn't**.

1. Citizens ______ respect the law.
2. Voters ______ show their ID card at the polling station.
3. You ______ sell your vote: it's illegal.
4. A judge ______ be independent.
5. Candidates ______ insult their opponents.
6. Leaders ______ steal public money.
7. We ______ respect the opinions of others.
8. You ______ share a message before checking it.

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Have to at other tenses and mistakes
exercises.statement:
**A. Mets la phrase au temps demandé avec have to.**
1. We wait three months for new desks. (prétérit)
2. The new delegates work with everybody. (futur)
3. She presents her programme. (question au présent)
4. You queue for a long time. (question au prétérit)

**B. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**

6. The mayor have to listen to citizens.
7. Yesterday we must wait for two hours.
8. Do you must vote in your country?
9. He don't have to come to the meeting.
10. You mustn't come if you are tired. (le sens voulu : ce n'est pas obligatoire)

exercises.title: Exercise 9 — Writing: what makes a good leader? (150-180 words)
exercises.statement:
**Topic:** "What makes a good leader?"

Écris un essai de **150 à 180 mots** en suivant le plan de la leçon Writing : introduction, trois qualités illustrées, conclusion avec ton opinion. Utilise au moins quatre modaux d'obligation. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Must or mustn't?
exercises.statement:
Complète avec **must** ou **mustn't**.

1. Citizens ______ respect the law.
2. Voters ______ show their ID card at the polling station.
3. You ______ sell your vote: it's illegal.
4. A judge ______ be independent.
5. Candidates ______ insult their opponents.
6. Leaders ______ steal public money.
7. We ______ respect the opinions of others.
8. You ______ share a message before checking it.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 3 — Antes y ahora; corrige los errores
exercises.statement:
**A. Complète chaque phrase : imperfecto pour « antes », présent pour « ahora ».**
1. Antes la gente ______ (mandar) cartas; ahora ______ (mandar) mensajes.
2. Antes nosotros ______ (ir) al banco; ahora ______ (pagar) con el móvil.
3. Antes los alumnos ______ (buscar) información en la biblioteca; ahora la ______ (buscar) en internet.

**B. Complète avec mientras et deux imperfectos.**
4. ______ mi padre ______ (escuchar) la radio, mi madre ______ (preparar) la cena.

**C. Chaque phrase contient une erreur. Corrige-la.**
5. Antes escuchava la radio.
6. Habían pocos ordenadores en mi escuela.
7. Cuando fui pequeña, jugaba con mis primos.
8. Nosotros escribiamos cartas.
9. Yo vía la tele con mi abuelo.
10. Antes tenemos que esperar mucho en la cabina.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 5 — Leer: comprensión del texto
exercises.statement:
Réponds aux questions sur le texte « África, el continente del móvil ».

**A. Comprensión global**
1. El texto: (a) explica cómo fabricar un teléfono (b) presenta los cambios que el móvil ha traído a África, sus ventajas y sus peligros (c) cuenta la historia de una empresa de Europa.

**B. Comprensión detallada**
2. ¿Cómo se comunicaban las familias en los pueblos hace treinta años? (dos maneras)
3. ¿Qué «salto tecnológico» dio África?

5. Antes del dinero móvil, ¿cómo enviaban dinero los trabajadores a su familia?

7. ¿Cómo usan el móvil los centros de salud?
8. Cita tres peligros de la tecnología.
9. ¿Qué es la «educación digital», según los expertos? (tres ejemplos)

**C. ¿Verdadero o falso? Justifica con una frase del texto.**
10. Según el viejo maestro, hoy el problema es la falta de información.

exercises.title: Ejercicio 6 — Leer: vocabulario e interpretación
exercises.statement:
**A. Busca en el texto la palabra que significa:**

6. «Antes, el problema era la falta de información; hoy, el problema es saber elegir la buena». ¿Qué quiere decir? ¿Cómo verificas tú una información antes de compartirla?

exercises.title: Ejercicio 9 — Escribir: la vida antes y ahora (120-150 palabras)
exercises.statement:
**Tema :** Écris un texte de **120 à 150 mots** qui compare la vie de tes grands-parents quand ils étaient jeunes et ta vie d'aujourd'hui (communication, information, loisirs, école). Donne ton avis : la vie était-elle meilleure avant ?

Suis le plan de la leçon Escribir. Utilise au moins huit imperfectos, dont era, iba et había. Écris ton texte, valide-le, puis compare avec l'exemple corrigé.

exercises.title: End-of-unit test — Writing and speaking tasks
exercises.statement:
Ces deux tâches complètent le **QCM de fin d'unité** (20 questions).

**1. Writing task (70-90 words).** You are running for class delegate. Write your campaign speech: three realistic promises and the rules you will respect. Use **must, have to, mustn't** and **don't have to** at least once each.

**2. Speaking task.** Enregistre-toi pendant **1 minute 30** : « Should young people take part in politics? Give your opinion. »

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Mustn't or don't have to?
exercises.statement:
Complète avec **mustn't** (interdiction) ou **don't / doesn't have to** (absence d'obligation).

1. You ______ vote for your best friend: vote for the best candidate.
2. You ______ write two names on your ballot, or it won't count.
3. In Congo, you ______ be a member of a party to vote.
4. A delegate ______ be the best pupil in the class.
5. Pupils ______ cheat during exams.
6. You ______ sign your ideas in the suggestion box.

Puis explique en français la différence entre « You mustn't come » et « You don't have to come ».

exercises.title: BAC paper 2 — Development
exercises.statement:
**SUJET TYPE BAC n° 2 — Theme: Development**

Travaille en temps limité, sans regarder le corrigé, puis corrige-toi.

**TEXT**

> Africa is a rich continent with poor people — a strange paradox. Its soil holds oil, gold and diamonds, yet millions lack schools and hospitals. The reason is often that raw materials are sold abroad while little is built at home. True development means transforming these resources into roads, jobs and knowledge, for the benefit of the whole population.

**I. READING (10 points)**

1. What is the "strange paradox"? (2 pts)
2. Name two riches of Africa's soil. (2 pts)
3. What do millions of people still lack? (2 pts)
4. What does "true development" mean according to the text? (2 pts)
5. Find a word meaning "changing into something else". (2 pts)

**II. LANGUAGE (5 points)**

a) Present perfect: The country ______ (build) many schools since independence. (1 pt)
b) Superlative: Africa is one of the ______ (rich) continents in resources. (1 pt)
c) Complete: Resources are sold ______ foreign companies. (by / with) (1 pt)
d) Give a noun from "develop": ______ (1 pt)
e) Connector of consequence: Resources are exported, ______ little is built at home. (1 pt)

**III. WRITING (5 points)**

Essay (about 120 words): "Natural resources can be a blessing or a curse for a country." Discuss.

exercises.title: BAC paper 3 — Music and sports
exercises.statement:
**SUJET TYPE BAC n° 3 — Theme: Music and sports**

Travaille en temps limité, sans regarder le corrigé, puis corrige-toi.

**TEXT**

> A champion is not born; a champion is made. Behind every medal there are years of early mornings, hard training and painful defeats. The same is true of a great musician, who practises long hours before the applause. Talent opens the door, but only discipline carries you through it.

**I. READING (10 points)**

1. According to the text, is a champion "born" or "made"? (2 pts)
2. What lies "behind every medal"? (2 pts)
3. What is said about a great musician? (2 pts)
4. Explain the last sentence in your own words. (2 pts)
5. Find a word meaning "regular practice in order to improve". (2 pts)

**II. LANGUAGE (5 points)**

a) Simple past: He ______ (win) the race last Sunday. (1 pt)
b) Past habit: When she was a child, she ______ sing in a choir. (1 pt)
c) Relative pronoun: The player ______ scored the goal is only seventeen. (1 pt)
d) Give the adverb that means "with a lot of effort": He works very ______. (1 pt)
e) Connector: He trained hard; ______, he won. (therefore / although) (1 pt)

**III. WRITING (5 points)**

Paragraph (about 100 words): Describe a sportsperson or a musician you admire and explain why.

exercises.title: BAC paper 6 — Transport
exercises.statement:
**SUJET TYPE BAC n° 6 — Theme: Transport**

Travaille en temps limité, sans regarder le corrigé, puis corrige-toi.

**TEXT**

> In many African cities, the morning rush hour means long traffic jams and polluted air. The cause is simple: too many private cars and too few buses. Experts agree that good public transport is the real solution. One modern bus can replace dozens of cars, saving time, fuel and clean air at the same time.

**I. READING (10 points)**

1. What does the morning rush hour mean in many African cities? (2 pts)
2. What is the "simple" cause of the problem? (2 pts)
3. What is "the real solution" according to experts? (2 pts)
4. What can one modern bus replace? What does it save? (2 pts)
5. Find an expression meaning "the time of day when traffic is heaviest". (2 pts)

**II. LANGUAGE (5 points)**

a) First conditional: If the city ______ (buy) more buses, traffic ______ (fall). (2 pts)
b) Will or going to? Look at the plans: they ______ build a new road. (1 pt)
c) Comparative: Buses are ______ (cheap) than taxis. (1 pt)
d) Connector of purpose: They bought new buses ______ reduce traffic. (in order to / because) (1 pt)

**III. WRITING (5 points)**

Report (about 120 words): Suggest three ways to improve transport in your area.

exercises.title: BAC paper 9 — Politics
exercises.statement:
**SUJET TYPE BAC n° 9 — Theme: Politics**

Travaille en temps limité, sans regarder le corrigé, puis corrige-toi.

**TEXT**

> Democracy is more than an election day. It is the daily behaviour of citizens who respect the law, pay their taxes and refuse corruption. Leaders must be honest and accountable, but citizens too have duties. A country is strong not only because of its leaders, but because of its people.

**I. READING (10 points)**

1. Democracy is "more than" what? (2 pts)
2. Give two daily behaviours of good citizens. (2 pts)
3. What must leaders be? (2 pts)
4. What does the text say about a country's strength? (2 pts)
5. Find a word meaning "who must explain and justify their actions". (2 pts)

**II. LANGUAGE (5 points)**

a) Modal of obligation: Citizens ______ respect the law. (1 pt)
b) Modal of prohibition: Leaders ______ steal public money. (1 pt)
c) Opinion phrase: Corruption is harmful. → In my ______, corruption is harmful. (1 pt)
d) Connector of addition: Leaders have duties; ______, citizens have duties too. (1 pt)
e) Give a noun from "corrupt": ______ (1 pt)

**III. WRITING (5 points)**

Essay (about 120 words): What qualities make a good leader?

exercises.title: Language drill — Word formation and connectors
exercises.statement:
Révise d'abord la leçon « Reference grammar » (§10 et §11).

**A. Donne le contraire avec un préfixe.**
1. possible → ______ 2. legal → ______ 3. agree → ______ 4. regular → ______ 5. employed → ______

**B. Donne le mot demandé.**
6. noun from "educate" → ______
7. noun from "happy" → ______
8. adjective from "danger" → ______
9. adjective meaning "without use" → ______
10. adverb from "careful" → ______

**C. Choisis le connecteur qui convient : however, because of, so that, although, therefore.**
11. ______ he was tired, he finished his homework.
12. The match was cancelled ______ the rain.
13. She saved money ______ she could buy a sewing machine.
14. Prices have risen. ______, many families cannot buy meat.
15. The country is rich in oil. ______, many people are still poor.

exercises.title: BAC paper 5 — Famous lives
exercises.statement:
**SUJET TYPE BAC n° 5 — Theme: Famous lives**

Travaille en temps limité, sans regarder le corrigé, puis corrige-toi.

**TEXT**

> Those we remember longest are rarely those who had the most money. We remember men and women who served others: leaders who fought for freedom, doctors who healed the poor, teachers who opened minds. Their true wealth was courage and generosity, and that wealth never dies.

**I. READING (10 points)**

1. According to the text, who do we "remember longest"? (2 pts)
2. Give two examples of people we remember. (2 pts)
3. What was their "true wealth"? (2 pts)
4. Explain: "that wealth never dies". (2 pts)
5. Find a word meaning "bravery". (2 pts)

**II. LANGUAGE (5 points)**

a) Past perfect: Before he became famous, he ______ (work) for the poor for years. (1 pt)
b) Relative pronoun: The doctor ______ healed them is admired by everybody. (1 pt)
c) Reported speech: "I will serve my country," she said. → She said that she ______ serve her country. (1 pt)
d) Give a noun from "generous": ______ (1 pt)
e) Connector: He had no money; ______, he was admired by all. (nevertheless / so) (1 pt)

**III. WRITING (5 points)**

Biography (about 120 words): Write about the life of a person you admire.

exercises.title: BAC paper 7 — Demographic, ecological and social problems
exercises.statement:
**SUJET TYPE BAC n° 7 — Theme: Demographic, ecological and social problems**

Travaille en temps limité, sans regarder le corrigé, puis corrige-toi.

**TEXT**

> Our forests are disappearing. Every year, trees are cut down for wood and farmland, and they are rarely replaced. Without forests, the soil grows poor, rivers dry up and the climate changes. Protecting trees is therefore not a luxury but a necessity. Planting a tree today is a gift to tomorrow's children.

**I. READING (10 points)**

1. What is happening to the forests? (2 pts)
2. Why are trees cut down? (2 pts)
3. Name two consequences of losing forests. (2 pts)
4. Is protecting trees "a luxury"? Justify with the text. (2 pts)
5. Find a word meaning "something that is absolutely needed". (2 pts)

**II. LANGUAGE (5 points)**

a) Put into the passive: People cut down thousands of trees every year. (1 pt)
b) Connector of consequence: Forests disappear; ______ the soil grows poor. (1 pt)
c) Give the opposite with a prefix: appear → ______ (1 pt)
d) Modal of obligation: We ______ protect the forests. (1 pt)
e) Give a noun from "protect": ______ (1 pt)

**III. WRITING (5 points)**

Essay (about 120 words): What can young people do to protect the environment?

exercises.title: BAC paper 10 — Development and health
exercises.statement:
**SUJET TYPE BAC n° 10 — Theme: Development and health**

Travaille en temps limité, sans regarder le corrigé, puis corrige-toi.

**TEXT**

> A nation's greatest wealth is not its gold but its people. A child who is well fed, healthy and educated will one day build roads, cure the sick and teach others. This is why spending on health and education is never a waste: it is the wisest investment a country can make in its own future.

**I. READING (10 points)**

1. According to the text, what is "a nation's greatest wealth"? (2 pts)
2. What will a well-fed, healthy and educated child do one day? (3 pts)
3. Why is spending on health and education "never a waste"? (2 pts)
4. What is called "the wisest investment"? (2 pts)
5. Find a word meaning "money spent today to obtain a future benefit". (1 pt)

**II. LANGUAGE (5 points)**

a) Superlative: It is the ______ (wise) investment. (1 pt)
b) Put into the passive: A country makes this investment. (1 pt)
c) Relative pronoun: A child ______ is educated helps the nation. (1 pt)
d) Connector of cause: We spend money on schools ______ children are the future. (1 pt)
e) Give a noun from "educate": ______ (1 pt)

**III. WRITING (5 points)**

Essay (about 120 words): "Health and education are the best investments a country can make." Do you agree?

exercises.title: Language drill — Past perfect and reported speech
exercises.statement:
Ces deux points n'ont pas d'unité propre : révise-les dans la leçon « Reference grammar » (§1 et §4).

**A. Past perfect ou prétérit ? Mets les verbes à la bonne forme.**
1. When we arrived at the station, the train ______ (already / leave).
2. She ______ (pass) her baccalaureate before she ______ (find) a job.
3. I ______ (never / see) the sea before I ______ (go) to Pointe-Noire.

**B. Mets au discours rapporté.**

exercises.title: Short reading texts 1 to 5 — quick training
exercises.statement:
**Entraînement rapide au Reading.** Lis chaque texte et réponds aux questions par des phrases complètes.

**Text 1 — Food and health**
> Many students skip breakfast, thinking they save time. In fact, they lose energy and concentration for the whole morning. The brain needs fuel to work, and breakfast is the best fuel of the day. A simple meal of bread, fruit and milk is enough. Students who eat a good breakfast remember their lessons better and feel less tired. So the few minutes "saved" by skipping breakfast are, in truth, minutes lost.

1. Why do students skip breakfast? 2. What does the brain need to work? 3. Give an example of a simple breakfast. 4. What advantage do students who eat breakfast have? 5. Why are the minutes "saved" really "lost"?

**Text 2 — Development**
> A road is more than stones and tar. When a new road reaches a village, children can go to school more easily, farmers can sell their crops in town, and sick people can reach a hospital. In this way, a single road can change many lives at once. This is why development experts say that infrastructure is the backbone of progress: without roads, water and electricity, even the best ideas stay on paper.

1. A road is "more than" what? 2. Name three changes a new road brings to a village. 3. What do experts call infrastructure? 4. What three examples of infrastructure are given? 5. What happens to ideas without infrastructure?

**Text 3 — Music and sports**
> When the national team plays, something strange happens: people who never speak to each other suddenly become friends. In the street, in the market, everyone talks about the same match. For ninety minutes, differences of tribe, religion and wealth seem to disappear. This is the hidden power of sport: it unites a nation around a shared emotion. Music does the same thing. A popular song can bring a whole country to its feet.

1. What "strange" thing happens during a national match? 2. Where do people talk about the match? 3. What differences "seem to disappear"? 4. What is "the hidden power of sport"? 5. What can music do, according to the text?

**Text 4 — The North/South divide**
> A farmer in the South grows cocoa and sells it very cheaply. Thousands of kilometres away, in the North, a factory turns that same cocoa into expensive chocolate. The farmer earns a few coins; the factory earns a fortune. This simple story explains much of the North/South divide. The solution is not charity but justice: if Southern countries could process their own raw materials, they would keep the profit at home.

1. What does the Southern farmer grow, and how does he sell it? 2. What does the Northern factory do with the cocoa? 3. Compare what each one earns. 4. What does this story explain? 5. What solution does the text propose?

**Text 5 — Famous lives**
> Wangari Maathai was a woman from Kenya who understood a simple truth: to protect people, you must protect nature. She founded a movement that planted millions of trees. At first people laughed, then they followed her. In 2004 she received the Nobel Peace Prize — the first African woman to do so. Her life proves that one determined person, armed only with an idea and courage, can change a nation.

1. Where was Wangari Maathai from? 2. What "simple truth" did she understand? 3. What did her movement do? 4. What prize did she receive, and when? 5. What does her life prove?

exercises.title: Language drill — The four conditionals
exercises.statement:
Révise d'abord la leçon « Reference grammar » (§2).

**A. Mets les verbes à la bonne forme (type indiqué).**
1. (type 0) If you ______ (heat) water to 100 °C, it ______ (boil).
2. (type 1) If it ______ (rain) tomorrow, the match ______ (be) cancelled.
3. (type 2) If I ______ (be) the president, I ______ (build) a hospital in every town.
4. (type 2) If she ______ (have) more money, she ______ (start) a business.
5. (type 3) If he ______ (study) harder, he ______ (pass) his exam last year.
6. (type 3) If we ______ (leave) earlier, we ______ (not / miss) the train.

**B. Quel type ? Explique le sens de chaque phrase en français.**
7. If I win the competition, I will buy a guitar.
8. If I won the competition, I would buy a guitar.
9. If I had won the competition, I would have bought a guitar.

1. **must** — obligation donnée par le médecin (ordre fort).
2. **had better** — conseil urgent, sinon une conséquence négative (« or you'll get wet »).
3. **mustn't** — c'est interdit avant l'analyse.
4. **don't have to** — ce n'est pas nécessaire (et non interdit).
5. **should** ou **ought to** — simple recommandation, opinion personnelle.
6. **had better** ou **must** — situation urgente.

**1. Exemple de message :**

Hi Jordan! You told me you want to lose weight, so here is my advice. First, you should stop drinking sodas: drink water instead. You ought to eat more vegetables and fish, and less fried food. You had better walk to school instead of taking the bus — it's free exercise! Finally, you must be patient: you can't lose weight in one week. Good luck! Kevin

Nowadays, many young people think that health problems only concern old people. In my opinion, we should take care of our health from an early age.

First of all, good habits are easier to learn when we are young. A teenager who eats a balanced diet, drinks water and exercises regularly will probably keep these habits as an adult.

Moreover, many diseases start early. For example, eating junk food and drinking sodas every day can lead to obesity and diabetes, even among students. As a result, prevention is better than cure.

Finally, good health helps us succeed at school. When we sleep well and do not skip meals, we can concentrate in class and prepare for the baccalaureate.

To conclude, young people ought to see their health as an investment. Schools and families had better help them before it is too late.

Development is one of the biggest challenges for African countries. Many people believe that education is the key to it, and I largely agree with this idea.

First of all, education gives people the skills they need to find jobs and improve their standard of living. An educated farmer can use better techniques, and a trained engineer can build roads and bridges.

Secondly, education improves health. Educated mothers know more about hygiene and nutrition, so their children are healthier. Since the 1960s, literacy rates have increased in Congo, and life expectancy has also risen.

However, education alone is not enough. A country also needs investment, infrastructure and good governance. Many young graduates in Congo have not found work yet, because the economy still relies too much on oil.

To conclude, education is a necessary key to development, but it must open real doors. That is why the government ought to invest both in schools and in the creation of jobs.

**Exemple de production corrigée (≈ 160 mots, personnage imaginaire)**

The person I admire most is Grâce Mabiala, a young Congolese singer who has become a symbol of hope for many girls.

Grâce was born in Brazzaville in 2001. As a child, she used to sing in her church choir every Sunday, and she used to listen to her grandfather's old rumba records. Her family was poor, so she sold doughnuts after school to help her mother.

At sixteen, she took part in a talent competition on television. She didn't win, but a producer noticed her and offered her a contract. Two years later, she recorded her first album, which mixed rumba with afro-pop. The album became a huge success, and she performed in Kinshasa, Abidjan and Paris.

Today, Grâce still lives in Brazzaville and she helps young artists in her neighbourhood.

I admire her because she never gave up. She shows that talent, hard work and humility can open every door.

**Exemple de production corrigée (≈ 175 mots)**

Today, the world is still divided between a rich North and a poorer South. Yet Southern countries are rich in resources. How can they reduce the gap?

First of all, they must invest in education. Skilled workers are the most precious resource of a nation. For example, well-trained engineers can run factories and stop the brain drain.

Secondly, Southern countries should process their raw materials at home. A bar of chocolate is far more profitable than a bag of cocoa beans. If Congo transformed its timber into furniture, it would create thousands of jobs.

Another solution is cooperation between African countries. Trade between neighbours is easier and cheaper than trade with distant continents, and together we are stronger.

Finally, good governance is essential, so that wealth benefits the whole population and not only a few.

To conclude, aid is useful in emergencies, but it is not as effective as education and industry. In my view, the South will develop only when it takes its future into its own hands.

Life in a rich country is easier than life in a developing country. Incomes are higher, so families can afford better food and housing. Hospitals are better equipped, and life expectancy is longer. Schools have more computers and fewer pupils per class. However, life in rich countries is also more expensive and more stressful. In developing countries, people are often poorer, but family solidarity is stronger. The biggest difference is opportunity: young people in the South have fewer chances to find a good job.

**Introduction.** The aim of this report is to describe the transport problems of our town and to suggest some solutions.

**Current situation.** At present, the main roads are crowded at rush hour, and it can take an hour to cross the town. Many minibuses are old and produce exhaust fumes. Moreover, motorbike taxis cause many accidents, because most riders don't wear helmets.

Today, plastic waste is one of the most serious problems in our towns. Plastic bags, bottles and sachets of water can be seen everywhere: in the streets, in the gutters and on the beaches.

This situation has several causes. First, plastic is cheap and practical, so people use it every day. Secondly, rubbish is not collected regularly in many neighbourhoods, because there are not enough bins and lorries.

The consequences are serious. When it rains, the gutters are blocked by plastic; as a result, the streets are flooded and houses are damaged. Moreover, plastic is eaten by fish and animals, and burning it pollutes the air we breathe.

To conclude, plastic is not a fatality. If everybody acts, our towns will be cleaner and healthier.

8. She asked me **where I lived**. (pas d'inversion, do disparaît)
9. The teacher asked us **if (whether) we were ready**.
10. The coach told the players **not to shout**. (ordre négatif : not to + base)

**A.**
1. If you **heat** water to 100 °C, it **boils**.
2. If it **rains** tomorrow, the match **will be** cancelled.
3. If I **were** the president, I **would build** a hospital in every town.
4. If she **had** more money, she **would start** a business.
5. If he **had studied** harder, he **would have passed** his exam last year.
6. If we **had left** earlier, we **would not (wouldn't) have missed** the train.

**B.**
7. **Type 1** : condition réelle et possible. « Si je gagne le concours, j'achèterai une guitare » (c'est possible).
8. **Type 2** : situation imaginaire. « Si je gagnais le concours, j'achèterais une guitare » (c'est peu probable ou hypothétique).
9. **Type 3** : situation passée qui ne s'est pas réalisée (regret). « Si j'avais gagné le concours, j'aurais acheté une guitare » (mais je n'ai pas gagné).

**Ejemplo de mensaje corregido (≈ 145 palabras)**

¡Hola, Santiago!

¡Qué bien que vienes a Pointe-Noire! Te explico cómo llegar a mi casa desde la estación de autobuses.

Primero, sal de la estación y gira a la derecha. Sigue todo recto hasta el cruce, donde hay un gran mercado. Después, cruza la avenida y coge un taxi. Dile al taxista que vas al barrio de Tié-Tié, a la farmacia de la Paz. El taxi cuesta unos mil francos y tardas quince minutos si no hay atasco.

Mi casa está enfrente de la farmacia, al lado de una tienda de móviles. Es una casa blanca con una puerta verde.

Ten cuidado con las motos y lleva tu documento de identidad. Y si te pierdes, llámame enseguida.

¡Hasta el sábado!

Un abrazo,

Divine

**Grille d'auto-évaluation (sur 20)** : forme du message et clarté du trajet (4) · contenu (trajet, transport, conseils) (5) · vocabulaire de la ville et des transports (4) · grammaire : impératif, prépositions (5) · orthographe, accents et ponctuation (2).

**I. READING**
1. **Long traffic jams and polluted air.**
2. **Too many private cars and too few buses.**
3. **Good public transport.**
4. It can replace **dozens of cars**; it saves **time, fuel and clean air**.
5. **the (morning) rush hour**

**II. LANGUAGE**
a) If the city **buys** more buses, traffic **will fall**. (présent après if, will dans la principale)
b) **are going to** (évidence visible : les plans)
c) **cheaper**
d) **in order to** (but)

**III. WRITING — modèle (≈ 125 mots)**

**Improving transport in our area**

**Introduction.** The aim of this report is to suggest three ways to make transport in our area faster and safer.

**Current situation.** Every morning, the main avenue is blocked by cars, minibuses and motorbike taxis. Accidents are frequent, and the air is polluted.

**Recommendations.** First, the council should create a bus lane on the main avenue, so that buses can move quickly. Secondly, the potholes must be repaired and traffic lights installed at the busiest crossroads. Thirdly, helmets should be compulsory for motorbike riders and their passengers.

**Conclusion.** If these measures are adopted, journeys will be shorter, there will be fewer accidents and the air will be cleaner.

**A.**
1. **Sigue todo recto hasta el semáforo.**
2. **Toma la segunda calle a la derecha.**
3. **La farmacia está al lado del banco.**
4. **Coge el autobús número 3.**

**B.**
5. **Cruza la calle y gira a la izquierda.**
6. **Perdone, señora, ¿dónde está el hospital?**
7. **Coja (tome) el taxi, el aeropuerto está lejos.**
8. **Ven a mi casa el sábado y llámame cuando llegues a la estación.**
